title: Prove a consumer before merging its producer
when: Merging a producer candidate that changes a declared consumed contract
need: Run ordinary producer verification and merge. The merge boundary dispatches the consumer-owned workflow against the exact published producer candidate and an immutable consumer commit tag, then records its verdict on the producer item. Failure names the consumer run and job; fix that failure and retry. Verification alone needs no companion or steering dispatch; consumer code changes require a linked companion.
surface: Merge gate output, producer QA consumer requirement and consumer-proof guide
review: Focused candidate tests cover both merge routes; live rollout proof remains unclaimed.
